operations.title: Limpar Cache DNS

operations.title: Limpar Cache do Discord

operations.title: Remover Arquivos .tmp do Sistema

operations.title: Listar Processos por Uso de RAM

operations.title: Reativar SuperFetch (SysMain)

operations.title: Reiniciar Serviço de Áudio

operations.title: Verificar Status dos Serviços de Áudio

operations.title: Reparar Arquivos do Sistema (DISM/SFC)

operations.title: Verificar Modo de Memória Virtual
operations.command: $cs = Get-ComputerInfo; Write-Host "Paginação: $($cs.OsMaxProcessMemorySize) KB" -ForegroundColor Cyan

operations.title: Limpar Standby Memory (RAMMap)
operations.command: Write-Host "Baixe RAMMap da Sysinternals para limpar Standby Memory manualmente." -ForegroundColor Yellow

operations.title: Listar Processos Ativos
operations.command: Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 Name,Id,CPU,@{N="RAM(MB)";E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,1)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Encerrar Processo por Nome

operations.title: Encerrar Todos Edge
operations.command: Stop-Process -Name "msedge" -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Edge encerrado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Listar Serviços em Execução
operations.command: Get-Service | Where-Object Status -eq "Running" | Sort-Object DisplayName | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Listar Startups do Sistema
operations.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand | Select-Object Name,Command,User | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Desativar Serviço por Nome

operations.title: Reiniciar Explorer
operations.command: Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force; Start-Process explorer; Write-Host "✅ Explorer reiniciado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Ver tarefas agendadas
operations.command: Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object State -eq "Ready" | Select-Object TaskName,TaskPath | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Verificar Espaço em Disco
operations.command: Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Select-Object Name,@{N="Usado(GB)";E={[math]::Round(($_.Used/1GB),2)}},@{N="Livre(GB)";E={[math]::Round(($_.Free/1GB),2)}},@{N="Total(GB)";E={[math]::Round((($_.Used+$_.Free)/1GB),2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize
operations.description: Verifica e retorna o espaço usado, livre e total de todos os discos.

operations.title: Encontrar Pastas Gigantes (C:)
operations.command: Get-ChildItem C: -Directory | ForEach-Object { $s=(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -EA 0 | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum; [PSCustomObject]@{Pasta=$_.Name;GB=[math]::Round($s/1GB,2)} } | Sort-Object GB -Desc | Select-Object -First 15 | Format-Table

operations.command: Resolve-DnsName google.com; Resolve-DnsName cloudflare.com

operations.command: "8.8.8.8","1.1.1.1","208.67.222.222" | ForEach-Object { $r=Test-Connection $_ -Count 1 -EA 0; Write-Host "$_ -> $($r.ResponseTime)ms" }

operations.title: Relatório rápido do PC
operations.command: $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu=Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object -First 1; $disk=Get-PSDrive C; $ramLivre=[math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $ramTotal=[math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2); $diskLivre=[math]::Round($disk.Free/1GB,2); $diskTotal=[math]::Round(($disk.Used+$disk.Free)/1GB,2); $boot=[Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDateTime($os.LastBootUpTime); $uptime=New-TimeSpan -Start $boot -End (Get-Date); Write-Host "===== RELATORIO RAPIDO DO PC =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Computador: $env:COMPUTERNAME"; Write-Host "Windows: $($os.Caption) Build $($os.BuildNumber)"; Write-Host "CPU: $($cpu.Name)"; Write-Host "RAM: $ramLivre GB livre de $ramTotal GB"; Write-Host "Disco C: $diskLivre GB livre de $diskTotal GB"; Write-Host "Uptime: $($uptime.Days)d $($uptime.Hours)h"; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "Top 10 processos por RAM:" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name,@{N="RAM(MB)";E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host ""; if(Test-Connection 8.8.8.8 -Count 1 -Quiet){Write-Host "Internet: OK" -ForegroundColor Green}else{Write-Host "Internet: SEM CONEXAO" -ForegroundColor Red}
operations.description: Gera um relatório rápido do PC com Windows, uptime, RAM, disco C, top 10 processos e internet.

operations.title: Exportar diagnóstico para logs
operations.command: $project=$env:MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH; if(-not $project){ throw "MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH não definido." }; $logDir=Join-Path $project "logs"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir | Out-Null; $file=Join-Path $logDir ("diagnostico-"+(Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss")+".txt"); $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $disk=Get-PSDrive C; $top=Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name,@{N="RAM(MB)";E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,2)}} | Out-String; @("===== DIAGNOSTICO MESTRE DO PC =====","Data: $(Get-Date)","Computador: $env:COMPUTERNAME","Windows: $($os.Caption) Build $($os.BuildNumber)","RAM livre GB: $([math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2))","Disco C livre GB: $([math]::Round($disk.Free/1GB,2))","",$top) | Set-Content -Path $file -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Diagnostico salvo em: $file" -ForegroundColor Green
operations.description: Exporta um diagnóstico rápido para a pasta logs com nome diagnostico-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.txt.

operations.title: Listar modelos Ollama
operations.command: try { $data=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:11434/api/tags" -TimeoutSec 5); Write-Host "Modelos Ollama instalados:" -ForegroundColor Cyan; if(-not $data.models){ Write-Host "Nenhum modelo retornado pelo Ollama." -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { $data.models | ForEach-Object { $cloud=if($_.name -match "cloud"){ " [cloud]" } else { "" }; Write-Host ("- " + $_.name + $cloud) } } } catch { Write-Host "Ollama offline ou inacessivel em localhost:11434" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host $_.Exception.Message }

operations.title: Testar Ollama (qwen3-coder-next:cloud)

Talvez o modelo nao suporte chat ou esteja offline." -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host $_.Exception.Message }

operations.title: Ver tarefas MestreDoPC
operations.command: $names=@("MestreDoPC_Admin_Launcher","MestreDoPC_Startup"); $rows=foreach($name in $names){ $task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($task){ $info=Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [pscustomobject]@{Task=$name;State=$task.State;LastRun=$info.LastRunTime;LastResult=$info.LastTaskResult;NextRun=$info.NextRunTime} } else { [pscustomobject]@{Task=$name;State="Nao encontrada";LastRun="";LastResult="";NextRun=""} } }; $rows | Format-Table -AutoSize
operations.description: Lista as tarefas agendadas MestreDoPC_Admin_Launcher e MestreDoPC_Startup, quando existirem.

operations.title: Checkup Geral (Resumo Completo)
operations.command: $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu=Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor; $disk=Get-PSDrive C; $ram=[math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,1); $totalRam=[math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,1); $diskFree=[math]::Round($disk.Free/1GB,1); $diskTotal=[math]::Round(($disk.Used+$disk.Free)/1GB,1); $up=[Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDateTime($os.LastBootUpTime); $days=([datetime]::Now-$up).Days; Write-Host "=== CHECKUP DO PC ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "CPU: $($cpu.Name)" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "RAM: $ram GB livre de $totalRam GB" -ForegroundColor $(if($ram -lt 2){"Red"}else{"Green"}); Write-Host "Disco C: $diskFree GB livre de $diskTotal GB" -ForegroundColor $(if($diskFree -lt 20){"Red"}else{"Green"}); Write-Host "Uptime: $days dias" -ForegroundColor $(if($days -gt 7){"Yellow"}else{"Green"}); Write-Host "Windows: $($os.Caption) Build $($os.BuildNumber)" -ForegroundColor White

templates.title: Encerrar Processo
templates.pattern: Stop-Process -Name "{{NOME}}" -Force -EA 0; if ($?) { Write-Host "✅ Processo {{NOME}} encerrado com sucesso!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Processo {{NOME}} não encontrado ou já encerrado." -ForegroundColor Yellow }
templates.description: Encerra um processo pelo nome. Informe o parâmetro 'nome' com o nome do processo (ex: chrome, notepad).

templates.title: Desativar Serviço
templates.pattern: Set-Service -Name "{{NOME_SERVICO}}" -StartupType Disabled -EA 0; Stop-Service -Name "{{NOME_SERVICO}}" -Force -EA 0; if ($?) { Write-Host "✅ Serviço {{NOME_SERVICO}} desativado!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Serviço {{NOME_SERVICO}} não encontrado." -ForegroundColor Yellow }
templates.description: Desativa e para um serviço do Windows pelo nome. Informe 'nome_servico' (ex: wuauserv, SysMain, Spooler).

templates.title: Desinstalar Atualização Específica
templates.pattern: wusa /uninstall /kb:{{NUMERO_KB}} /quiet /norestart; Write-Host "Substitua NUMERO_KB pelo KB desejado." -ForegroundColor Yellow

templates.title: Atualizar Driver por Hardware ID
templates.pattern: pnputil /add-driver "{{CAMINHO_INF}}" /install; Write-Host "Substitua CAMINHO.inf pelo caminho do driver." -ForegroundColor Yellow

templates.title: Remover modelo Ollama
templates.pattern: ollama rm {{NOME_MODELO}}

templates.title: Ver informações de um modelo Ollama
templates.pattern: ollama show {{NOME_MODELO}}
templates.description: Ver informações de um modelo Ollama.

templates.title: Copiar modelo Ollama
templates.pattern: ollama cp {{MODELO_ORIGEM}} {{MODELO_DESTINO}}

templates.title: Criar modelo Ollama a partir de Modelfile
templates.pattern: ollama create {{NOME_MODELO}} -f "{{CAMINHO_MODFILE}}"

templates.title: Pull de modelo Ollama customizado
templates.pattern: ollama pull {{NOME_MODELO}}

templates.title: Run modelo Ollama interativo
templates.pattern: ollama run {{NOME_MODELO}}

templates.title: Scan de Portas (Test-NetConnection)
templates.command: 1..1024 | ForEach-Object { $r = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 127.0.0.1 -Port $_ -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; if ($r.TcpTestSucceeded) { Write-Host "Porta $_ ABERTA" -ForegroundColor Green } }

templates.title: Listar Todas as Conexões TCP/UDP
templates.command: Get-NetTCPConnection | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,RemoteAddress,RemotePort,State,OwningProcess | Sort-Object State | Format-Table -AutoSize

templates.title: Listar Conexões LISTENING
templates.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -EA 0; [PSCustomObject]@{Porta=$_.LocalPort;Processo=$p.Name;PID=$_.OwningProcess} } | Format-Table -AutoSize

templates.title: Descobrir Hosts Ativos (ARP Scan)
templates.command: Get-NetNeighbor | Where-Object { $_.State -ne 'Unreachable' } | Select-Object IPAddress,LinkLayerAddress,State,InterfaceAlias | Format-Table -AutoSize

templates.title: Verificar SMBv1 (EternalBlue)
templates.command: Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol | Select-Object FeatureName,State; if ((Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol).State -eq 'Enabled') { Write-Host '⚠️ SMBv1 ATIVO - Vulnerável a EternalBlue!' -ForegroundColor Red } else { Write-Host '✅ SMBv1 desativado' -ForegroundColor Green }

templates.title: Desativar SMBv1 (EternalBlue)
templates.command: Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol -NoRestart; Write-Host '✅ SMBv1 desativado! Reinicie o PC.' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Verificar RDP Ativo
templates.command: Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name fDenyTSConnections | Select-Object fDenyTSConnections; if ((Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name fDenyTSConnections).fDenyTSConnections -eq 0) { Write-Host '⚠️ RDP ATIVO - Verifique segurança!' -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { Write-Host '✅ RDP desativado' -ForegroundColor Green }

templates.title: Verificar Conta de Convidado (Guest)
templates.command: Get-LocalUser | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Guest' } | Select-Object Name,Enabled; if ((Get-LocalUser -Name Guest -EA 0).Enabled) { Write-Host '⚠️ Conta Guest ATIVA!' -ForegroundColor Red } else { Write-Host '✅ Conta Guest desativada' -ForegroundColor Green }

templates.title: Verificar UAC Ativo
templates.command: Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name EnableLUA | Select-Object EnableLUA; if ((Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name EnableLUA).EnableLUA -eq 1) { Write-Host '✅ UAC ativo' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '⚠️ UAC DESATIVADO!' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Listar Compartilhamentos Abertos
templates.command: Get-SmbShare | Select-Object Name,Path,Description,ConcurrentUserLimit | Format-Table -AutoSize

templates.title: Verificar Certificados Raiz
templates.command: Get-ChildItem Cert:\LocalMachine\Root | Select-Object Subject,NotAfter,Thumbprint | Sort-Object NotAfter | Format-Table -AutoSize

templates.title: Verificar Logins Falhados (Security Log)

templates.title: Verificar Logins Bem-sucedidos

templates.title: Exportar Logs de Segurança para CSV

templates.command: Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 HotFixID,Description,InstalledOn,InstalledBy | Format-Table -AutoSize

templates.title: Buscar CVEs por Hotfix (NVD)
templates.pattern: Start-Process "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/search/results?query={{KB}}"; Write-Host 'Abrindo NVD para pesquisa...' -ForegroundColor Cyan

templates.title: Verificar Política de Senha
templates.command: net accounts

templates.title: Forçar Senha Forte (Política)
templates.command: net accounts /minpwlen:12 /maxpwage:30 /minpwage:1; Write-Host '✅ Política de senha configurada: mín 12 chars, expira em 30 dias' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Desativar Cache de Credenciais
templates.command: Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name 'CachedLogonsCount' -Value 0 -EA 0; Write-Host '✅ Cache de credenciais desativado!' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Desativar PowerShell v2 (Reduz Superfície de Ataque)
templates.command: Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName MicrosoftWindowsPowerShellV2Root -NoRestart -EA 0; Write-Host '✅ PowerShell v2 desativado!' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Ativar Auditoria de Alterações de Arquivo
templates.command: auditpol /set /subcategory:'File System' /success:enable /failure:enable; Write-Host '✅ Auditoria de sistema de arquivos ativada!' -ForegroundColor Green
templates.description: Ativar Auditoria de Alterações de Arquivo.

templates.title: Renomear Conta de Administrador
templates.command: Rename-LocalUser -Name 'Administrator' -NewName 'AdminSeguro'; Write-Host '✅ Conta Administrator renomeada para AdminSeguro!' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Desativar SMBv1 via Registro
templates.command: Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters' -Name 'SMB1' -Value 0 -EA 0; Write-Host '✅ SMBv1 desativado via registro!' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Ativar BitLocker (C:)
templates.command: Enable-BitLocker -MountPoint 'C:' -EncryptionMethod XtsAes256 -UsedSpaceOnly -TpmProtector; Write-Host '✅ BitLocker ativado em C:!' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: chmod 644 (Dono: RW, Outros: R)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /inheritance:r; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "$env:USERNAME:(M)"; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "Todos:(R)"; Write-Host '✅ chmod 644 aplicado' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: chmod 755 (Dono: RWX, Outros: RX)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /inheritance:r; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "$env:USERNAME:(F)"; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "Todos:(RX)"; Write-Host '✅ chmod 755 aplicado' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: chmod 600 (Apenas Dono: RW)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /inheritance:r; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "$env:USERNAME:(M)"; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /remove "Todos" 2>$null; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /remove "Convidados" 2>$null; Write-Host '✅ chmod 600 aplicado' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: chmod 700 (Apenas Dono: RWX)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /inheritance:r; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "$env:USERNAME:(F)"; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /remove "Todos" 2>$null; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /remove "Convidados" 2>$null; Write-Host '✅ chmod 700 aplicado' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: chmod 777 (Todos: RWX - PERIGOSO)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /inheritance:r; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "Todos:(F)"; Write-Host '⚠️ chmod 777 aplicado: TODOS têm acesso total!' -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: chmod 444 (Todos: Somente Leitura)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /inheritance:r; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "$env:USERNAME:(R)"; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "Todos:(R)"; Write-Host '✅ chmod 444 aplicado' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: chown user:group (Alterar Dono e Grupo)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { takeown /f "{{CAMINHO}}" /a; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /setowner {{DONO}}; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "{{DONO}}:(F)"; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "{{GRUPO}}:(F)"; Write-Host "✅ chown aplicado: dono={{DONO}}, grupo={{GRUPO}}" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: chown user (Alterar Apenas Dono)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /setowner {{DONO}}; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "{{DONO}}:(F)"; Write-Host "✅ chown aplicado: dono alterado para {{DONO}}" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Verificar Permissões de Arquivo (icacls)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Verificar Permissões (ACL detalhada)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { (Get-Acl "{{CAMINHO}}").Access | Select-Object IdentityReference,FileSystemRights,AccessControlType,IsInherited | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Conceder Permissão Total (Full Control)
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "{{USUARIO}}:(F)"; Write-Host "✅ Permissão total concedida a {{USUARIO}}" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Conceder Permissão de Leitura (Read)
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "{{USUARIO}}:(R)"; Write-Host "✅ Permissão de leitura concedida a {{USUARIO}}" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Conceder Permissão de Escrita (Write/Modify)
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "{{USUARIO}}:(M)"; Write-Host "✅ Permissão de escrita concedida a {{USUARIO}}" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Conceder Permissão de Execução (Execute)
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "{{USUARIO}}:(X)"; Write-Host "✅ Permissão de execução concedida a {{USUARIO}}" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Negar Acesso a Usuário (Deny)
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /deny "{{USUARIO}}:(F)"; Write-Host "✅ Acesso negado a {{USUARIO}}" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Remover Permissões de Usuário
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /remove {{USUARIO}}; Write-Host "✅ Permissões de {{USUARIO}} removidas" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Resetar Permissões (Herdar do diretório pai)
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /reset; Write-Host '✅ Permissões resetadas (herdando do diretório pai)' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Verificar Proprietário do Arquivo (chown)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO}}") { (Get-Acl "{{CAMINHO}}").Owner; Write-Host "Proprietário: $((Get-Acl "{{CAMINHO}}").Owner)" -ForegroundColor Cyan } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Alterar Proprietário do Arquivo (takeown)
templates.pattern: takeown /f "{{CAMINHO}}"; Write-Host '✅ Proprietário alterado para o usuário atual' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Aplicar Permissões Recursivamente (pasta)
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /grant "{{USUARIO}}:({{PERMISSAO}})" /t /c; Write-Host "✅ Permissão {{PERMISSAO}} aplicada recursivamente a {{USUARIO}}" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Backup de Permissões (ACL)
templates.pattern: $bak = "{{CAMINHO}}" + '.acl.bak'; icacls "{{CAMINHO}}" /save $bak; Write-Host "✅ Permissões salvas em: $bak" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Restaurar Permissões (ACL)
templates.pattern: icacls "{{DIRETORIO}}" /restore "{{CAMINHO}}"; Write-Host '✅ Permissões restauradas' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Wi-Fi Info Completo (SSID, Sinal, Canal)
templates.command: netsh wlan show interfaces | Format-List

templates.title: Testar Gateway (Ping Roteador)
templates.command: $g = (Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).NextHop; if($g) { Test-Connection $g -Count 4 | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { Write-Host 'Gateway não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Testar Internet (Múltiplos Servidores)
templates.command: Write-Host 'Testando conectividade...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; @('8.8.8.8','1.1.1.1','9.9.9.9','208.67.222.222') | ForEach-Object { $r = Test-Connection $_ -Count 1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($r) { Write-Host "[$_] OK - $($r.ResponseTime)ms" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "[$_] FALHOU" -ForegroundColor Red } }

templates.title: Testar DNS (Google + Cloudflare)
templates.command: Write-Host '=== Teste de DNS ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; @('google.com','cloudflare.com','microsoft.com') | ForEach-Object { try { $r = Resolve-DnsName $_ -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "[$_] OK - $($r[0].IPAddress)" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host "[$_] FALHOU" -ForegroundColor Red } }

templates.title: Testar HTTPS (Porta 443)
templates.command: Write-Host '=== Teste HTTPS (443) ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; @('google.com','cloudflare.com','microsoft.com') | ForEach-Object { $r = Test-NetConnection $_ -Port 443 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; if($r.TcpTestSucceeded) { Write-Host "[$_] HTTPS OK" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "[$_] HTTPS FALHOU" -ForegroundColor Red } }

templates.title: Wi-Fi Redes Próximas
templates.command: netsh wlan show networks mode=bssid | Out-String

templates.title: IPConfig Completo (Todos os Adaptadores)
templates.command: ipconfig /all

templates.title: Flush DNS + Renovar IP (DHCP)
templates.command: ipconfig /flushdns; ipconfig /release; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; ipconfig /renew; Write-Host '✅ DNS flush e IP renovado!' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Ver Cache ARP (Dispositivos na Rede)
templates.command: arp -a

templates.title: Portas Locais em Escuta
templates.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess,@{N='Programa';E={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Sort-Object LocalPort | Format-Table -AutoSize

templates.title: Conexões Estabelecidas
templates.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Established | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,RemoteAddress,RemotePort,@{N='Programa';E={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

templates.title: Tabela de Rotas (Routes)
templates.command: route print

templates.title: Testar Ollama (localhost:11434)
templates.command: try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:11434' -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing; if($r.StatusCode -eq 200) { Write-Host '✅ Ollama ONLINE' -ForegroundColor Green; $m = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host "Modelos: $(($m.models | ForEach-Object { $_.name }) -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Cyan } } catch { Write-Host '❌ Ollama offline: ' $_.Exception.Message -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Wi-Fi Força do Sinal (Barras)
templates.command: $s = [math]::Round((netsh wlan show interfaces | Select-String 'Sinal' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line -replace '[^0-9]','' }),0); $b = [math]::Ceiling($s/20); $bar = '█' * $b + '░' * (5 - $b); Write-Host "Sinal: $s% [$bar]" -ForegroundColor Cyan

templates.title: Trace Route (Tracert)
templates.command: $d = Read-Host 'Destino'; if($d) { tracert $d } else { Write-Host 'Informe o destino. Ex: tracert google.com' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

templates.title: Speed Test Mini (1MB Download)
templates.command: $t = Measure-Command { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://speedtest.tele2.net/1MB.zip' -OutFile "$env:TEMP\speedtest.tmp" -UseBasicParsing }; $mb = 1; $s = [math]::Round($t.TotalSeconds,2); $mbps = [math]::Round(($mb * 8) / $s,2); Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\speedtest.tmp" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "Velocidade estimada: ~$mbps Mbps (download de 1MB em ${s}s)" -ForegroundColor Cyan

templates.title: Backup Completo do Registro
templates.command: $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir "registry-backup-$date.reg"; reg export HKLM $backupFile /y; reg export HKCU $backupFile /y; Write-Host "✅ Backup do registro salvo em: $backupFile" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Backup de Drivers Instalados
templates.command: $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups\Drivers"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; pnputil /export-driver * $backupDir; Write-Host "✅ Drivers exportados para: $backupDir" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Backup de Programas Instalados
templates.command: $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir "programas-instalados-$date.txt"; Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\* | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName } | Select-Object DisplayName,DisplayVersion,Publisher,InstallDate | Sort-Object DisplayName | Out-File -FilePath $backupFile -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "✅ Lista salva em: $backupFile" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Backup de Configuração de Rede
templates.command: $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir "network-config-$date.txt"; netsh interface dump | Out-File -FilePath $backupFile -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "✅ Config de rede salva em: $backupFile" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Backup de Chaves de Registro Específicas
templates.command: $KeyPath = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion"; $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $keyName = $KeyPath -replace '\\','_'; $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir "registry-$keyName-$date.reg"; reg export $KeyPath $backupFile /y; Write-Host "✅ Chave $KeyPath exportada para: $backupFile" -ForegroundColor Green
templates.description: Backup de Chaves de Registro Específicas.

templates.title: Temperatura CPU (Leitura Direta)
templates.command: try { $temp = Get-WmiObject MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature -Namespace 'root/wmi' | ForEach-Object { [math]::Round(($_.CurrentTemperature - 2732) / 10, 1) }; Write-Host "Temperatura CPU: $temp °C" -ForegroundColor $(if($temp -gt 80){'Red'}elseif($temp -gt 60){'Yellow'}else{'Green'}) } catch { Write-Host '⚠️ Sensor de temperatura não disponível via WMI. Use HWMonitor ou OpenHardwareMonitor.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

templates.title: Monitoramento Contínuo de Temperatura
templates.command: for($i=1; $i -le 10; $i++) { try { $temp = Get-WmiObject MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature -Namespace 'root/wmi' | ForEach-Object { [math]::Round(($_.CurrentTemperature - 2732) / 10, 1) }; Write-Host "[$i] CPU: $temp °C - $(Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm:ss')" -ForegroundColor $(if($temp -gt 80){'Red'}elseif($temp -gt 60){'Yellow'}else{'Green'}) } catch { Write-Host 'Leitura indisponível' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5 }

templates.title: Monitorar Temperatura GPU
templates.command: try { $gpu = Get-WmiObject Win32_VideoController; foreach($g in $gpu) { Write-Host "GPU: $($g.Name)" -ForegroundColor Cyan; $temp = Get-WmiObject -Namespace 'root/openhardwaremonitor' -Class Sensor -Filter "SensorType='Temperature'" -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*GPU*' -or $_.Name -like '*Video*' } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Value; if($temp) { Write-Host "  Temperatura: $temp °C" -ForegroundColor $(if($temp -gt 85){'Red'}elseif($temp -gt 70){'Yellow'}else{'Green'}) } else { Write-Host '  Sensor indisponível' -ForegroundColor Yellow } } } catch { Write-Host '⚠️ Instale Open Hardware Monitor para leitura GPU' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

templates.title: Alerta Temperatura Alta
templates.command: $threshold = 85; try { $temp = Get-WmiObject MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature -Namespace 'root/wmi' | ForEach-Object { [math]::Round(($_.CurrentTemperature - 2732) / 10, 1) }; if($temp -ge $threshold) { Write-Host "⚠️ ALERTA: Temperatura CRÍTICA ($temp °C)" -ForegroundColor Red; [System.Console]::Beep(1000, 500); [System.Console]::Beep(1000, 500) } else { Write-Host "✅ Temperatura normal: $temp °C" -ForegroundColor Green } } catch { Write-Host 'Sensor indisponível' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

templates.title: Listar Todos os Drivers Instalados
templates.command: Get-WmiObject Win32_PnPSignedDriver | Where-Object {$_.DriverDate -ne $null} | Select-Object DeviceName,DriverVersion,Manufacturer,@{N='Data';E={[Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDateTime($_.DriverDate).ToString('dd/MM/yyyy')}} | Sort-Object DeviceName | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap

templates.title: Atualizar Drivers via Windows Update
templates.command: pnputil /scan-devices; pnputil /install-device *; Write-Host "✅ Busca e instalação de drivers iniciada!" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Reinstalar Driver de Dispositivo
templates.command: $DeviceName = 'Audio'; $device = Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object {$_.FriendlyName -like "*$DeviceName*"} | Select-Object -First 1; if($device) { Disable-PnpDevice -InstanceId $device.InstanceId -Confirm:$false; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Enable-PnpDevice -InstanceId $device.InstanceId -Confirm:$false; Write-Host "✅ Driver de '$DeviceName' reinstalado!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Dispositivo '$DeviceName' não encontrado" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

templates.title: Rollback de Driver (Versão Anterior)
templates.command: $DeviceName = 'Video'; $device = Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object {$_.FriendlyName -like "*$DeviceName*"} | Select-Object -First 1; if($device) { pnputil /enum-drivers | Select-String -Pattern $device.InstanceId -Context 2; Write-Host "⚠️ Use 'pnputil /delete-driver <oem#.inf>' para remover driver antigo" -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Dispositivo '$DeviceName' não encontrado" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

templates.title: Exportar Lista Completa de Drivers
templates.command: $backupDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Backups"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backupDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $backupFile = Join-Path $backupDir "drivers-list-$date.csv"; Get-WmiObject Win32_PnPSignedDriver | Where-Object {$_.DriverDate -ne $null} | Select-Object DeviceName,DriverVersion,Manufacturer,DriverDate | Export-Csv -Path $backupFile -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "✅ Lista exportada: $backupFile" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Listar Todos os Apps UWP
templates.command: Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers | Select-Object Name,Version,Architecture,InstallLocation | Sort-Object Name | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap

templates.title: Reinstalar Todos Apps Padrão
templates.command: Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers | Foreach { Add-AppxPackage -DisableDevelopmentMode -Register "$($_.InstallLocation)\AppXManifest.xml" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host "✅ Apps UWP reinstalados!" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Reset de App UWP Específico
templates.command: $AppName = 'Microsoft.WindowsCalculator'; $app = Get-AppxPackage | Where-Object {$_.Name -like "*$AppName*"} | Select-Object -First 1; if($app) { Get-AppxPackage $app.Name | Reset-AppxPackage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "✅ App '$AppName' resetado!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ App '$AppName' não encontrado" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

templates.title: Limpar Cache de Todos os Apps UWP
templates.command: $appData = $env:LOCALAPPDATA; $packages = Get-ChildItem "$appData\Packages" -Directory; foreach($pkg in $packages) { $cachePath = Join-Path $pkg.FullName "AppCache"; if(Test-Path $cachePath) { Remove-Item $cachePath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $tempPath = Join-Path $pkg.FullName "TempState"; if(Test-Path $tempPath) { Remove-Item $tempPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Host "✅ Cache de apps UWP limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green
templates.description: Limpa Cache de Todos os Apps UWP.

templates.title: Diagnóstico de Apps UWP
templates.command: Write-Host "=== DIAGNÓSTICO UWP ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; $total = (Get-AppxPackage).Count; $corrupted = Get-AppxPackage | Where-Object { $_.InstallLocation -eq $null }; Write-Host "Total de apps: $total" -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "Apps corrompidos: $($corrupted.Count)" -ForegroundColor $(if($corrupted.Count -gt 0){'Red'}else{'Green'}); if($corrupted.Count -gt 0) { $corrupted | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $($_.Name)" -ForegroundColor Yellow } }

templates.title: Otimizar TRIM (Todos os Drives)
templates.command: $drives = Get-PhysicalDisk | Where-Object {$_.MediaType -eq 'SSD' -or $_.MediaType -eq 'Unspecified'}; foreach($drive in $drives) { $driveLetter = (Get-Partition -DiskNumber $drive.DeviceId | Where-Object {$_.DriveLetter}).DriveLetter; if($driveLetter) { Write-Host "Otimizando drive $driveLetter..." -ForegroundColor Yellow; Optimize-Volume -DriveLetter $driveLetter -ReTrim -Verbose } }; Write-Host "✅ TRIM executado nos SSDs!" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Verificar Saúde Completa do SSD
templates.command: Get-PhysicalDisk | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "=== $($_.FriendlyName) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Tipo: $($_.MediaType)" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "Saúde: $($_.HealthStatus)" -ForegroundColor $(if($_.HealthStatus -eq 'Healthy'){'Green'}else{'Red'}); Write-Host "Tamanho: $([math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)) GB" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "Status: $($_.OperationalStatus)" -ForegroundColor White; if($_.HealthStatus -ne 'Healthy') { Write-Host "⚠️ DISCO COM PROBLEMAS!" -ForegroundColor Red } }

templates.title: Histórico de Uso do SSD (SMART)
templates.command: Get-PhysicalDisk | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "=== $($_.FriendlyName) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "⚠️ Dados SMART disponíveis via Get-PhysicalDisk. Use CrystalDiskInfo para análise detalhada." -ForegroundColor Yellow }

templates.title: Verificar Alinhamento de Partições
templates.command: Get-Partition | ForEach-Object { $offset = $_.Offset; $aligned = ($offset % 1MB) -eq 0; Write-Host "$($_.DriveLetter):) Offset: $offset bytes - $(if($aligned){'✅ Alinhado'}else{'⚠️ NÃO Alinhado!'}" -ForegroundColor $(if($aligned){'Green'}else{'Red'}) }

templates.title: Otimizar Windows para SSD
templates.command: fsutil behavior query disabledeletenotify | Select-String '0' | ForEach-Object { Write-Host '✅ TRIM já está habilitado' -ForegroundColor Green }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' -Name 'PrefetchParameters' -Value 3 -Force; Write-Host '✅ Prefetch otimizado para SSD' -ForegroundColor Green; Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'Microsoft\Windows\Defrag\ScheduledDefrag' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '✅ Desfragmentação automática desativada' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Monitorar Uso de CPU, RAM e Disco
templates.command: for($i=1; $i -le 5; $i++) { $cpu = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average).Average; $ram = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $ramPct = [math]::Round((($ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize - $ram.FreePhysicalMemory) / $ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize) * 100, 1); $disk = Get-PSDrive C; $diskPct = [math]::Round(($disk.Used / ($disk.Used + $disk.Free)) * 100, 1); Write-Host "[$i] CPU: $cpu% | RAM: $ramPct% | Disco: $diskPct%" -ForegroundColor $(if($cpu -gt 80 -or $ramPct -gt 80){'Red'}else{'Green'}); Start-Sleep -Seconds 3 }
templates.description: Monitora Uso de CPU, RAM e Disco.

templates.title: Exportar Relatório Completo (HTML)
templates.command:
$reportDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "MestrePC-Relatorios"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $reportDir | Out-Null; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $reportFile = Join-Path $reportDir "relatorio-$date.html"; $os = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu = Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Select-Object -First 1; $ram = [math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $totalRam = [math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2); $disk = Get-PSDrive C; $html = @" Relatório do Sistema

Relatório do PC - $(Get-Date -Format 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')

Informações Gerais

  • Windows: $($os.Caption) Build $($os.BuildNumber)
  • CPU: $($cpu.Name)
  • RAM: $ram GB livre de $totalRam GB
  • Disco C: $([math]::Round($disk.Free/1GB,2)) GB livre
"@; $html | Out-File -FilePath $reportFile -Encoding UTF8; Start-Process $reportFile; Write-Host "✅ Relatório gerado: $reportFile" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Agendar Limpeza Diária Automática
templates.command: $taskName = 'MestrePC-LimpezaDiaria'; $script = 'Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Clear-RecycleBin -Force -EA 0'; $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'PowerShell.exe' -Argument "-NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command \"$script\""; $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At 3am; $principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -RunLevel Highest; Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Principal $principal -Force; Write-Host "✅ Tarefa '$taskName' agendada diariamente às 03:00!" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Enviar Status para Discord (Webhook)
templates.command: $WebhookUrl = $env:MESTRE_DISCORD_WEBHOOK; if(-not $WebhookUrl) { Write-Host '⚠️ Defina MESTRE_DISCORD_WEBHOOK nas variáveis de ambiente' -ForegroundColor Yellow; return }; $os = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average).Average; $ram = [math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $body = @{ content = "**Mestre do PC - Status**`n🖥️ PC: $env:COMPUTERNAME`n⚙️ CPU: $cpu%`n💾 RAM Livre: $ram GB`n🪟 Windows: $($os.Caption)" } | ConvertTo-Json; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $WebhookUrl -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; Write-Host "✅ Status enviado para Discord!" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Enviar Notificação para Teams (Webhook)
templates.command: $WebhookUrl = $env:MESTRE_TEAMS_WEBHOOK; if(-not $WebhookUrl) { Write-Host '⚠️ Defina MESTRE_TEAMS_WEBHOOK nas variáveis de ambiente' -ForegroundColor Yellow; return }; $body = @{ text = "🔔 **Mestre do PC**`nStatus do sistema: $env:COMPUTERNAME`nData: $(Get-Date -Format 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')" } | ConvertTo-Json; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $WebhookUrl -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; Write-Host "✅ Notificação enviada para Teams!" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Listar Locais Comuns do PC
templates.command: $locais = @(@{Nome='Desktop'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')}, @{Nome='Downloads'; Caminho=(Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads')}, @{Nome='Documentos'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyDocuments')}, @{Nome='Imagens'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyPictures')}, @{Nome='Musica'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyMusic')}, @{Nome='Videos'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyVideos')}, @{Nome='TEMP do Usuario'; Caminho=$env:TEMP}, @{Nome='TEMP do Windows'; Caminho=(Join-Path $env:windir 'Temp')}, @{Nome='Program Files'; Caminho=$env:ProgramFiles}, @{Nome='Program Files (x86)'; Caminho=${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}}, @{Nome='AppData Local'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('LocalApplicationData')}, @{Nome='AppData Roaming'; Caminho=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('ApplicationData')}); $locais | ForEach-Object { $p = $_.Caminho; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { $itens = (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Force -EA 0 | Measure-Object).Count; [PSCustomObject]@{ Local = $_.Nome; Caminho = $p; Itens = $itens; Existe = 'Sim' } } else { [PSCustomObject]@{ Local = $_.Nome; Caminho = $p; Itens = 0; Existe = 'Nao' } } } | Sort-Object Local | Format-Table -AutoSize
templates.description: Lista os locais comuns do PC (Desktop, Downloads, Documentos, TEMP, Program Files, AppData etc.) com contagem de itens e se existem.

templates.title: Instalar Pacote NPM (Global)
templates.pattern: npm install -g {{PACOTE}}; Write-Host "✅ Pacote {{PACOTE}} instalado!" -ForegroundColor Green
templates.description: Instala um pacote NPM globalmente. Informe o parâmetro 'pacote' com o nome do pacote (ex: typescript, nodemon).

templates.title: Desinstalar Pacote NPM (Global)

templates.description: Desinstala um pacote NPM global. Informe o parâmetro 'pacote' com o nome do pacote.

templates.title: Resolver DNS Reverso (IP → Nome)
templates.pattern: Resolve-DnsName -Name {{IP_ALVO}} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Type,NameHost | Format-Table -AutoSize

templates.title: Verificar Hashes de Arquivos (MD5/SHA256)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}") { Write-Host 'MD5:' (Get-FileHash "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" -Algorithm MD5).Hash; Write-Host 'SHA256:' (Get-FileHash "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Testar HTTPS de um Site
templates.pattern: try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "{{URL_TESTE}}" -Method Head -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Host 'Status:' $r.StatusCode; Write-Host 'Certificado válido' -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host 'Erro:' $_.Exception.Message -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Análise de Arquivo (file type)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}") { $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}")[0..3]; $hex = ($bytes | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('X2') }) -join ' '; Write-Host "Assinatura (hex): $hex" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Tamanho: $((Get-Item "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}").Length) bytes" } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Verificar Metadados de Arquivo
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}") { Get-Item "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" | Select-Object Name,Length,CreationTime,LastAccessTime,LastWriteTime,Attributes | Format-List } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Extrair Hash de Arquivo (Todos os Algoritmos)
templates.pattern: if (Test-Path "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}") { foreach ($algo in @('MD5','SHA1','SHA256','SHA384','SHA512')) { Write-Host "$algo`: $((Get-FileHash "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" -Algorithm $algo).Hash)" -ForegroundColor Cyan } } else { Write-Host 'Arquivo não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }

templates.title: Listar Arquivos Modificados Recentemente (24h)
templates.pattern: Get-ChildItem "{{DIRETORIO_ALVO}}" -Recurse -File -EA 0 | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -gt (Get-Date).AddHours(-24) } | Select-Object FullName,LastWriteTime,Length | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 30 | Format-Table -AutoSize

templates.title: Conceder Leitura + Execução (RX)
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" /grant "{{NOME_USUARIO}}:(RX)"; Write-Host "✅ Permissão de leitura + execução concedida a {{NOME_USUARIO}}" -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Desativar Herança de Permissões
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" /inheritance:d; Write-Host '✅ Herança desativada - permissões copiadas' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Ativar Herança de Permissões
templates.pattern: icacls "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" /inheritance:e; Write-Host '✅ Herança ativada' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Alterar Proprietário para Administradores
templates.pattern: takeown /f "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" /a; icacls "{{CAMINHO_ARQUIVO}}" /grant Administradores:(F); Write-Host '✅ Proprietário alterado para Administradores' -ForegroundColor Green

templates.title: Listar Arquivos Sem Dono (Orphaned ACLs)
templates.pattern: Get-ChildItem "{{DIRETORIO_ALVO}}" -Recurse -File -EA 0 | ForEach-Object { try { $acl = Get-Acl $_.FullName -EA 0; if ($acl.Owner -match 'S-1-5') { [PSCustomObject]@{Arquivo=$_.FullName; Owner=$acl.Owner} } } catch {} } | Format-Table -AutoSize
